findings.evidence: figureArrow clones polygon attributes only, moves it from original group ancestry to root defs, and does not resolve inherited fill/stroke/stroke-width or CSS selector effects. Source producer heads have explicit fill, so simple generated examples are not proof for all styled imports. A nested parent stroke changes polygon outline while marker relocation loses that ancestry. A head clip-path/mask in userSpaceOnUse also remains in original coordinate frame while polygon points become local.
findings.minimalFix: Restrict accepted groups/heads to known plain producer attributes or materialize safe effective inherited presentation on the marker polygon; reject unsupported coordinate-bound effects rather than silently converting. Add actual parent-style/clipping regressions.

findings.evidence: ids uses root.querySelectorAll([id]), which excludes root itself. svg id=engine-arrow-0 with no descendant ids permits a marker with the same ID. Fragment resolution is then ambiguous; do not claim an exploit or definite browser outcome without DOM test.
findings.minimalFix: Reserve root id along with all descendant ids before allocation.
